title: Signed first-variable shift compatibility of the internal-Hom line comparison
statement:
Let $(\mathcal C,R)$ be a ringed site small in the module universe [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology, def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Use its unbounded derived category $D(R)$ [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], the ordinary derived tensor $\otimes_R^L$, namely the total tensor complex [def-pc-tensor-complex-sheaves] after K-flat replacement of the first factor [def-pc-kflat-complex], and $H(A,B)=R\mathcal Hom_R(A,B)$ [def-pur-derived-internal-hom], with the derived tensor--internal-Hom adjunction and signed shift identifications of [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-internal-hom-exact-restriction]; transposes below are taken for this adjunction. Let $T$ be an $R$-module sheaf locally isomorphic to $R$, placed in degree zero. Fix $r,s\in\mathbf Z$ with $r$ even, and $K\in D(R)$, without a boundedness or perfectness hypothesis. Define
$$
a_{K,T[r]}:H(K,R)\otimes_R^L T[r]\longrightarrow H(K,T[r])
$$
to be the transpose of coefficient evaluation tensored with $1_{T[r]}$; define $a_{K[s],T[r]}$ in the same way. Under the cohomological shift conventions $C[s]^i=C^{i+s}$ and $d_{C[s]}=(-1)^s d_C$, let $b_{K,B,s}:H(K[s],B)\xrightarrow{\sim}H(K,B)[-s]$ be the first-variable shift identification. Then the square from $H(K[s],R)\otimes^L T[r]$ to $H(K,T[r])[-s]$ commutes:
$$
b_{K,T[r],s}\circ a_{K[s],T[r]}
=a_{K,T[r]}[-s]\circ\bigl(b_{K,R,s}\otimes1_{T[r]}\bigr),
$$
where on the right one inserts the usual tensor-shift isomorphism $H(K,R)[-s]\otimes^L T[r]\cong(H(K,R)\otimes^L T[r])[-s]$. The maps are those of the Hom complex [def-pur-hom-complex] and total tensor [def-pc-tensor-complex-sheaves]. On Hom-complex representatives the first-variable comparison reindexes $j=i+s$ and has degree-$n$ multiplier $(-1)^{sn}$; using any coherent normalization differing by a sign depending only on $s$ gives the same commuting square.
